description: Agent-based social adoption model on a weighted community-structured social network. Individuals update a binary behavior (e.g., public health practice) via peer influence, personal propensity, and policy campaign signals. Contacts are generated daily based on network structure and mobility biases; adoption dynamics include habit formation and fatigue.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Generates a weighted, community-structured small-world social network with homophily and strong/weak ties.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  assign community_id to each person ~ categorical(net_community_count) with near-equal sizes
  initialize base ring lattice with average degree ~ net_avg_degree
  with probability net_rewiring_prob, rewire edges to random nodes (Watts–Strogatz style)
  apply homophily: increase connection probability within same community by net_homophily_strength; adjust to maintain degree
  assign edge weights w ~ LogNormal(mean=net_weight_mean, std=net_weight_std)
  mark a fraction net_fraction_strong_ties of edges as strong and multiply their weights by 2
  store edges and weights in state.network
else:
  no-op
notes: Runs only at t=0; subsequent ticks are no-ops.
Homophily targeting within-community edges; maintain average degree via proportional adjustment.

modules.name: PolicyCampaign
modules.description: Produces a time-varying campaign intensity signal with ramp-up, pulses, and decay; interacts with agent trust.

notes: Agent-level effect is I * trust_i; trust heterogeneity is embedded in Person.trust_in_authorities.

modules.name: MobilityContact
modules.description: Generates daily peer exposure per person via stochastic contact sampling biased by tie strength and day-type; includes occasional mobility shocks.

update_rule.pseudocode:
is_weekend = (day % 7 in {5,6})
mult = weekend_multiplier if is_weekend else 1.0
if rand() < shock_probability:
  mult = mult * shock_magnitude
for each person i:
  k ~ Poisson(lambda = max(0.1, contact_rate_per_day) * mult * (1 + Normal(0, mobility_variance)))
  neighbors = N(i)
  p_j ∝ weight_ij ^ (1 + contact_bias_toward_strong_ties)
  sample min(k, |neighbors|) contacts without replacement by p_j
  exposure_i = mean(is_adopting of sampled neighbors) if k>0 else mean(is_adopting of neighbors) (fallback)
emit signal.peer_exposure[i] = exposure_i
notes: Fallback to static neighbor mean ensures defined exposure when k=0.
Weights emphasize strong ties when contact_bias_toward_strong_ties > 0.

modules.name: BehaviorAdoption
modules.description: Updates agent adoption states based on peer exposure, campaign intensity, personal propensity, habit formation, fatigue, and stochasticity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  social_term = influence_weight_social * susceptibility_to_influence_i * (peer_exposure_i - adoption_threshold_i)
  policy_term = influence_weight_policy * trust_in_authorities_i * signal.campaign_intensity
  personal_term = influence_weight_personal * (baseline_adoption_propensity_i + risk_perception_i - 0.5)
  habit_term = habit_strength_i
  fatigue_term = - fatigue_i
  linear_score = social_term + policy_term + personal_term + habit_term + fatigue_term + logistic_intercept + Normal(0, noise_scale)
  p_adopt = sigmoid(logistic_slope * linear_score)
  if is_adopting_i == False:
    new_state = Bernoulli(p_adopt)
  else:
    p_drop = sigmoid(logistic_slope * (-(social_term + policy_term + personal_term) + dropout_bias))
    new_state = Bernoulli(1 - p_drop)
  # habit and fatigue updates
  if new_state == True:
    habit_strength_i = habit_strength_i + habit_formation_rate * (1 - habit_strength_i)
    fatigue_i = max(0.0, fatigue_i + fatigue_rate)
  else:
    habit_strength_i = max(0.0, habit_strength_i - forgetting_rate)
    fatigue_i = max(0.0, fatigue_i - fatigue_rate)
  record adoption_events: +1 if (old_state=False and new_state=True), -1 if (old_state=True and new_state=False)
notes: Sigmoid(x) = 1 / (1 + exp(-x)); all probabilities clipped to [0,1].
Threshold acts as a personal tipping point relative to peer exposure.
Dropout uses a distinct bias to capture asymmetry.

modules.name: ObservationAggregator
modules.description: Computes daily observables: overall adoption rate, community adoption rates, churn, and new adoptions.

update_rule.pseudocode:
rate_overall = mean(Person.is_adopting)
rate_by_comm = group_mean(Person.is_adopting by Person.community_id)
churn = count(adoption_events == -1) / population_size
new_adopt = count(adoption_events == +1) / population_size
emit observable.adoption_rate_daily = smooth(rate_overall, window=smoothing_window_days)
emit observable.adoption_rate_by_community = smooth_by_group(rate_by_comm, window=smoothing_window_days)
emit observable.adoption_churn_daily = churn
emit observable.new_adoptions_daily = new_adopt
emit observable.campaign_intensity_daily = signal.campaign_intensity
notes: Smoothing is moving average with window >= 1 day.
Community reporting subset can be applied to sample a fraction of agents when < 1.0.

procedures: Create Person agents with attributes drawn from specified distributions.
Assign community_id uniformly across net_community_count communities.
Initialize network via NetworkBuilder at t=0.
Initialize Person.is_adopting = True for a random sample of size initial_adoption_fraction * N.
Initialize habit_strength = 0.0 for non-adopters, 0.4 for initial adopters; fatigue = 0.0 for all.

algorithms.NetworkGenerationWattsStrogatzHomophily: Construct a Watts–Strogatz small-world base and reweight edges to favor within-community ties per homophily strength; assign log-normal weights; mark strong ties.
algorithms.PeerInfluenceComputation: Daily Poisson contacts from neighbors sampled with probability proportional to weight^bias; exposure is mean adoption among sampled neighbors.
algorithms.PolicySchedulePiecewise: Piecewise campaign function with ramp, exponential decay, and periodic pulses; intensity bounded [0,1].
algorithms.AdoptionLogitWithHabitFatigue: Logistic adoption probability combining social, policy, personal, habit, and fatigue terms plus noise; asymmetric dropout; habit formation/decay updates.
algorithms.SmoothingMovingAverage: Compute moving average over specified window for selected observables.
